duration.text: The Aquaculture Education at Ningbo University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3000 USD/per year ￥ 21600 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK HSK level 6 for Arts applicants or level 3 for Science applicants. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant.(48mm*33mm) Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation Two reference letters from 2 professors respectively. Postgraduate school transcript

requirements.text: Applicants for Doctorates should hold a Master's degree and an HSK certificate(level 3 or above).
